(2) MEDIUM — docs-d10 with unmet tasks: Submit (F) then 'Keep editing' (studio-result-review-btn) -> both studio-task-t1-missing and studio-task-t2-missing red X remain and the 'Red items still need work…' hint persists; navigating to another mission (docs-m1) correctly resets to 0 red X (hasSubmitted reset). ui_bugs.issue: LOW/NEW: the picker's caption placeholder 'Insert table (columns × rows)' wraps to 2 lines in the ~140px popover, but on first hover it collapses to the 1-line 'C × R table', shifting the whole 6x6 grid up ~16px. Give the caption a fixed min-height (or shorten it) so the grid never moves.
